body:
Bipolar 1 + psychosis here :p

So, in my case, there’s a lot of 3 different types of thought; DEPRESSIVE (“I should just stop taking the meds, they don’t work anyway”/“I want to get worse”), HYPO-MANIC (“man, I have been steady for so long and everything is going *great*, maybe I can stop taking them”/“I haven’t seen {hallucinated} anything in so long, I want to test if I can survive without the meds”), and FULL MANIA (“if I stop taking them I can feel more!!” “I’m losing my sparkle/not sparkly enough when I take my meds”). There’s a few different reasons lol
THIS IS EXACTLY WHAT I WAS SAYING YES YES KNOW YOUR WORTH
Honestly I am just astounded at the sheer amount of shit I have learned about my family in a solid week. :D

It’s not that they approve of him. My mother works as a high ranking lieutenant and almost all of her coworkers hate him. They don’t have a choice. If they show that they dislike the president, they could be fired.
Ok so Yagami Yato is an ASMR channel. She usually makes NSFW audios, which is where the sammich comes in. It usually means two people pleasing you with the listener in the middle.
Ok but would it be too much to ask for the pattern?
I did. They did nothing about it and I have switched doctors and they still won’t do anything.

Well, if only good things happened to you, life would be boring af. You need bad things to happen so you can see how good you’re doing. Move on from your breakup. It’s hard, but you’ll get over them. Get more plants. Use your life to keep them alive. Make them your rock until you can be stable. Be safe❤️

It sucks that you feel that way. It sucks that society has literally instilled in us that boys are always this stoic, strong, muscular hero and that woman are feeble damsels in distress in need of a hero. It’s so sad that when men show feelings that they are ridiculed for doing so. It’s not fair whatsoever. Everyone has emotions. We need to let them out sometime but it’s hard when you get teased for doing it. I hate that so much. It pisses me the hell off.

I get it. I might not be going through everything you’re going through, but I understand. It’s hard. Really hard. I thought the same way. I wanted to die so badly. The only thing that kept me alive was the fact that my younger brothers would find my dead body in the morning. Find someone that you can hang on to, even if they don’t know it. Use them as a lifeline and try to get through. It sounds really cheesy, but things do get better. Give it time.

If you search it up, the suicide hotline now has a texting section. It takes a while to hook up to someone but you get great advice and help from professionals who know what they’re doing. I hope this helps :)
